layout_system:
SHELL (.shell): CSS grid, grid-template-columns var(--bar) minmax(0,1fr) var(--bar) where --bar = clamp(57px, 5.13vw, 74px) (≈74px at 1440 wide); grid-template-rows auto auto; align-content start; gap 20px; padding 20px; min-height 100vh; box-sizing border-box. Column 1 row 1 = left context bar (.ctxbar, align-self start, position relative, NOT sticky; its inline width 74px is overridden to width 100% of the bar column). Column 2 row 1 = the canvas (.dash). Column 3 = empty right gutter mirroring the left bar so the canvas stays centred. Row 2 spanning 1 / -1 = main bar (.mainbar), justify-self center, max-width 100%, position sticky, bottom 20px, flex-wrap wrap, justify-content center.
CANVAS GRID (.dash): display grid; grid-template-columns repeat(12, minmax(0,1fr)); grid-auto-rows minmax(72px, auto); gap 20px; min-width 0; align-self start. At 1440×934: canvas width ≈ 1440 − 40 padding − 2×74 bars − 2×20 gaps ≈ 1212px, so one column ≈ 82.7px and the 20px gutter is identical horizontally and vertically. A 3-row span = 3×72 + 2×20 = 256px minimum height (rows grow with content because of minmax(72px, auto)). Spans are expressed as columns × rows; every widget on this board is 3 rows tall. Widgets (.w) are flex columns, min-width 0, position relative; the body area is flex:1 so content stretches to fill the span; list rows use flex:1 so they distribute the height evenly.
DEFAULT ARRANGEMENT (three 12-column bands, each 3 rows): Band 1: 'Start a routine' span 7 (class c7) + 'Credits & tier' span 5 (c5). Band 2: 'Recent routines' span 4 (c4) + 'Insight · Week 41' span 4 (c4) + 'Consented partners' span 4 (c4). Band 3: 'My report' span 3 (c3) + 'Rewards catalog' span 5 (c5) + free cell span 4 × 3 rows (c4). Total at 1440×934: 3×256 + 2×20 = 808px canvas + 20px top padding, main bar beneath, everything fits without scrolling.
FREE-CELL PLACEHOLDER: an empty grid item spanning 4 columns × 3 rows with 1px dashed oklch(0.84 0.018 275) border, radius 12px, centred muted 14px/700 text '4 × 3 free · drop a widget here' (HTML comment: 'Empty grid slot: where a new or resized widget snaps'). It is where a newly added, unhidden or resized widget snaps.
SPAN VOCABULARY (from guide copy and the sizes board): Resize picks S, M, L or XL; 'small widgets show less, large ones show more, text never shrinks'; 'Everything snaps to the same grid, with the same gaps.' Spans defined on the sizes board: Recent routines S 3×2, M 4×3, L 5×3, XL 8×4; Start a routine S 4×2, M 7×3; Credits S 3×2, M 5×3. The desktop board uses the M size for every widget it shows those for (Start 7×3, Credits 5×3, Recent 4×3).
SNAPPING / DRAG / RESIZE: specified only in copy (drag by the title bar; widgets snap to the grid; Pin keeps a widget in place on auto-arrange; Arrange packs without gaps; Reset returns to default; Lock freezes the layout). Not implemented in the prototype: no drag handlers, Pin/Resize/Hide/Add/Arrange/Reset/Lock are inert.
BREAKPOINTS: (a) ≤1180px: shell columns become var(--bar) minmax(0,1fr) (right gutter dropped); canvas becomes 6 columns; .c7 and .c5 → span 6 (full width); .c4 and .c3 → span 3 (half). Resulting flow: Start 6 / Credits 6 / Recent 3 + Insight 3 / Partners 3 + Report 3 / Rewards 6 / free slot 3. Toolbar unit shrinks with 0.9vw down to the 10px floor (reached at ≈1111px). (b) ≤720px (phone): shell single column minmax(0,1fr); the left bar moves to grid row 1 as a horizontal, wrapping strip (flex-direction row, flex-wrap wrap, align-items center, width auto), its kicker/title header takes a full line (flex 1 1 100%, no bottom border, no bottom margin) and each tool tile becomes 4.3em wide; canvas moves to row 2 as one column with every widget span 1 (full width, keeps its row span); main bar moves to row 3, justify-self stretch, gap 4px, still wraps. Guide card at ≤720: width calc(100vw − 40px) !important, max-height 45vh, and its left limit is 20px instead of 'right of the left bar'.
PHONE NOTE: the separate phone board (page2.png) uses a different pattern (logo + avatar top row, bottom bar with a red play tile, 'History', 'Sharing' with red dot, 'Rewards', 'More', and a bottom action sheet titled 'WIDGET · Insight · Week 41' with buttons 'Confirm' (red), 'Past', 'Snooze', 'Pin', 'Hide' and a round close X; 'Start a routine' shows 'Partner: Yoav F. · approved, 14 days'). The desktop board's own ≤720 CSS does not produce that pattern.
Z-ORDER: widgets z-index auto (3 when they are the current guide target); main bar z-index 1 (3 during the main-bar guide step); left bar auto (3 during the ctxbar step and every widget step); scrim z-index 2; guide card z-index 4, position fixed.
chrome: TOP BAR: none on the desktop board. No page header, no breadcrumbs; the canvas starts directly under the 20px shell padding.

LEFT CONTEXT BAR (aside, aria-label 'Selected widget tools', data-guide 'ctxbar', classes ctx ctxbar): surface bg oklch(0.998 0.002 275), 1px oklch(0.9 0.012 275) border, radius .92em, padding .77em .62em, gap .31em, vertical flex column, width = bar column (≈74px). Header block (padding .31em .31em .62em, 1px bottom border, margin-bottom .31em): kicker {{ctxKicker}} 10px/800 uppercase letter-spacing .06em navy; title {{ctxTitle}} 12px/800 lh 1.2, margin-top 2px, overflow-wrap anywhere. Then the tool tiles from the current selection, then (only when a widget is selected) a 1px divider and four fixed tiles.

LEFT BAR TILE (button.tool): column flex, centred, gap .23em, min-height 4em (≈52px), padding .46em .15em, radius .92em, no border; 22px stroke icon above a 10px/700 label (lh 1.1, centred). States: normal = transparent bg, muted oklch(0.5 0.035 275); PRIMARY (first tool of a widget) = bg #BD2025, fg #fff; guide-highlighted = bg oklch(0.93 0.03 275), fg #0E153E, RING; intended CSS hover = bg oklch(0.975 0.006 275). aria-label = the tile label. Click handler is a no-op (run: () => {}) for every generated tile.

LEFT BAR, nothing selected: kicker 'Dashboard', title 'Nothing selected'; tiles 'Add' (plus), 'Arrange' (2×2 layout grid), 'Reset' (counter-clockwise reset arrow), 'Lock' (padlock). None is primary. No divider, no Pin/Resize/Hide/Esc. (Rendering at 74px: 'DASHBOARD' overflows the bar edge and the title breaks as 'Nothing selecte d' because of overflow-wrap anywhere.)

LEFT BAR, widget selected: kicker 'Widget', title = widget name; tiles per widget: Start a routine → 'Continue' (play, primary), 'Partner' (user-plus), 'Context' (chat bubble), 'Last used' (clock). Credits & tier → 'Redeem' (gift, primary), 'Rules' (book), 'Log' (clock). Recent routines → 'Open last' (external-link, primary), 'Copy cards' (copy), 'Reflect' (chat bubble), 'Filter' (funnel). Insight · Week 41 → 'Confirm' (check, primary), 'Past' (clock), 'Snooze' (bell). Consented partners → 'Request' (user-plus, primary), 'Review' (users), 'Revoke' (x). My report → 'Upload' (upload, primary), 'Privacy' (shield), 'Preview' (eye). Rewards catalog → 'Catalog' (gift, primary), 'Redeemed' (clock), 'Rules' (book).

LEFT BAR fixed tiles when a widget is selected (after a 1px oklch(0.9 0.012 275) divider, margin .31em 0): 'Pin' (aria-label 'Pin widget', pushpin icon, no handler), 'Resize' (aria-label 'Resize widget', diagonal maximize arrows, no handler), 'Hide' (aria-label 'Hide widget', eye-off, no handler), 'Esc' (aria-label 'Deselect', x icon stroke 2, 1px oklch(0.9 0.012 275) border, transparent; click → deselect, selected = 'none'). All muted colour, same tile metrics (4em min-height). Each can receive RING from the guide (hlPin, hlResize, hlHide, hlEsc).

MAIN BAR (nav, aria-label 'Dashboard', data-guide 'mainbar', classes ctx mainbar): surface bg, 1px oklch(0.9 0.012 275) border, radius .92em, padding .62em, gap .31em, flex row, align-items center, sticky at bottom 20px, centred, wraps when narrow. Item order left→right: [1] S3 logo link → 'Main.dc.html', aria-label 'S3 home', 44px square tile with 34px-tall logo. [2] 1px×28px divider (margin 0 .31em). [3] 'Start routine' button: red #BD2025 bg, white, 800 weight, font 1em (13px), height 3.4em (44px), padding 0 16px 0 12px, gap .62em, filled play triangle icon; click → selects the 'Start a routine' widget (pickStart); guide highlight key 'StartRoutine'. [4] 'History' (clock icon) → selects 'Recent routines'; key 'History'. [5] 'Sharing' (users icon) → selects 'Consented partners'; carries an 8px (.62em) red #BD2025 badge dot with a 2px surface-coloured border, absolutely positioned top .46em right 1.08em (= pending request); key 'Sharing'. [6] 'Report' (upload icon) → selects 'My report'; key 'Report'. [7] 'Rewards' (award/ribbon icon) → selects 'Rewards catalog'; key 'Rewards'. [8] divider. [9] 'Add' (plus, aria-label 'Add widget', no handler; key 'Add'). [10] 'Layout' (2×2 grid, aria-label 'Arrange layout', no handler; key 'Layout'). [11] 'Search' (magnifier, aria-label 'Search', no handler). [12] 'Theme' (moon, aria-label 'Appearance', no handler). [13] 'Guide' (help-circle, aria-label 'Open the guide') → starts the guide at step 1; key 'Guide'. [14] 'Org admin' link (users icon) → 'Admin.dc.html' (renders as a 44px square because the logo rule .mainbar>a applies to it; the icon collapses and the text wraps to 'Org / admin'). [15] divider. [16] Account button, aria-label 'Account: Dana Cohen, Captain', height 44px, padding 0 .92em 0 .31em, gap 10px: 36px navy circle with white 'DC' (13px/800), then 'Dana' (13px/800) over 'Captain' (11px muted), lh 1.15; no handler.

MAIN BAR icon buttons (button.main for History, Sharing, Report, Rewards, Add, Layout, Search, Theme, Guide): column flex, centred, gap .15em, width 4.9em (≈64px), height 3.7em (≈48px), radius .92em, transparent, muted colour, 22px icon over a 10px/700 label. Intended hover bg oklch(0.975 0.006 275). Can receive RING when a guide action row with the matching key is hovered. No active/selected state is drawn on main-bar buttons when their widget is selected.

BADGES/STATES in chrome: Sharing red dot (pending consent request); '1 pending' red text + 7px dot in the partners widget header; primary tile red in the left bar; disabled state exists only on the reward button 'Not enough credits'.

GUIDE CARD (aside, aria-label 'Live guide', classes guide ctx, data-guide-card): position fixed, z-index 4, width 340px, max-width calc(100vw − 40px), max-height calc(100vh − 126px), overflow auto, transition left .35s ease and top .35s ease, padding 18px, gap 12px, surface bg, 1px border, radius 12px, shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(14,21,62,0.10). Row 1: kicker 'Guide · step {{stepN}} of {{stepTotal}}' (renders 'GUIDE · STEP 1 OF 12', 11px/800 uppercase .06em navy) and 'Skip' button (32px, 13px/700 muted). Title 18px/800. Body 14px navy. Optional actions block (1px top border, padding-top 10px, gap 6px): kicker {{actionsLabel}} 11px/800 uppercase muted, then rows in a 96px | 1fr grid (gap 8px, margin 0 −8px, padding 4px 8px, radius 12px, 13px lh 1.4; label 800 navy, description muted; hover bg oklch(0.93 0.03 275)). Optional 'Try it:' box (padding 10px 12px, radius 12px, SOFT bg, 13px lh 1.4, bold navy 'Try it:' prefix). Footer (1px top border, padding-top 12px): 12 progress dots 6px with 5px gap (current #0E153E, past oklch(0.84 0.018 275), future oklch(0.9 0.012 275)), then 'Back' (hidden on step 1; 40px, 1px oklch(0.84 0.018 275) border, transparent, navy 14px/700) and 'Next' / 'Finish' (40px, red, white, 14px/700).

GUIDE SCRIM: fixed inset 0, z-index 2, rgba(14,21,62,0.5), pointer-events none, aria-hidden — the app stays fully usable under it (step 1 copy says so). The current target is lifted to z-index 3 with RING; the main bar keeps z-index 1 except on its own step.

widgets.title: Start a routine
widgets.header_meta: 'Solo, or with a consenting partner' (13px muted, right side of the title bar). Header is a full-width button, aria-label 'Select widget: Start a routine', with the six-dot drag handle at left.
widgets.content: Body (padding 16px 18px 18px, column, space-between, gap 16px). Row 1: five routine chips in a wrapping row (gap 8px), from ROUTINES = [flight 'Flight', simulator 'Simulator', training 'Training', debrief 'Debrief', coaching 'Coaching']; chip = button 40px tall, padding 0 16px, radius 12px, 14px/700; selected chip ('Flight' by default, state.routine='flight') = bg oklch(0.93 0.03 275), 1px #0E153E border, navy text; unselected = transparent, 1px oklch(0.84 0.018 275) border, navy text. Row 2 (1px top border oklch(0.9 0.012 275), padding-top 16px, wrapping, space-between, gap 12px): partner line 14px muted 'Partner for {{routineLabel}}: ' + bold navy 'Yoav F.' + ' · approved, valid 14 days' (renders 'Partner for Flight: Yoav F. · approved, valid 14 days'; only the routine label changes when another chip is picked, the partner name and validity are static) and the red CTA link 'Continue to briefing'.
widgets.default_span: 7 columns × 3 rows (class c7; 'M · 7×3' on the sizes board). ≤1180px: span 6 (full width of the 6-col grid). ≤720px: full width.
widgets.primary_action: 'Continue to briefing' — anchor to Main.dc.html (the briefing form), inline-flex, 44px tall, padding 0 22px, radius 12px, #BD2025 bg, white 700 text, no underline. Same action as the left-bar primary tile 'Continue'. The main bar 'Start routine' button only selects this widget.
widgets.left_bar_actions: Kicker 'Widget', title 'Start a routine'. 'Continue' (play icon, primary red) — guide: 'Go to the briefing form for the chosen routine.'; 'Partner' (user-plus) — 'Switch between solo and a consented partner.'; 'Context' (chat bubble) — 'Add aircraft, phase and scenario before generating.'; 'Last used' (clock) — 'Repeat your previous routine setup.'; then Pin, Resize, Hide, Esc.
widgets.opens: Continue → Main.dc.html (briefing form, then action cards). Suggested repo target: the routine/briefing form at /app (src/app/app/page.tsx) and the generated session at /app/routines/[id].
widgets.sizes: S · 4×2 (sizes board): title 'Start a routine' only, then a single picker button 'Flight · Yoav F.' with a chevron-down (aria-label 'Routine: Flight') replacing the chips, plus an icon-only red play link (aria-label 'Continue to briefing'); annotation 'at S the primary action stays, chips collapse to a picker, secondary text goes to the left bar'. M · 7×3: exactly the desktop content (header meta, five chips, partner line, 'Continue to briefing'). No L/XL defined.
widgets.states: Default: Flight selected, widget not selected. Clicking a chip sets routine and also selects the widget (outline + left bar switches). Selected: 2px #0E153E inner outline. Guide target (step 4): z-index 3 + RING. Implied but not drawn: no verified report → routine generation blocked (guide step 9); no consenting partner for the chosen routine → solo; partner pending.
widgets.action_sheet: Not drawn on the phone board for this widget; by the same pattern as the Insight sheet it would be 'Continue' (red), 'Partner', 'Context', 'Last used', 'Pin', 'Hide' plus a close X.

widgets.title: Credits & tier
widgets.header_meta: 'Ready → Proficient' (13px muted). Header aria-label 'Select widget: Credits and tier'.
widgets.content: Body (padding 16px 18px 18px, column, space-between, gap 10px). Row 1 (baseline, space-between): '180' (34px/800, letter-spacing −0.02em, lh 1) followed by ' credits' (14px/700 muted, letter-spacing 0); right: '340 / 500' (13px/700, tabular-nums). Row 2: progress bar role progressbar, aria-label 'Tier progress', aria-valuenow 68, min 0, max 100: 8px track oklch(0.93 0.03 275), radius 12px, fill 68% #0E153E. Row 3: '160 more credits to Proficient · 2-week streak' (13px muted). Data semantics implied by the numbers: 180 = spendable balance (matches rewards: 250 − 180 = '70 more credits needed'), 340 / 500 = tier progress points toward Proficient (500 − 340 = 160), current tier 'Ready', next tier 'Proficient', streak 2 weeks.
widgets.default_span: 5 columns × 3 rows (class c5; 'M · 5×3'). ≤1180px: span 6. ≤720px: full width.
widgets.primary_action: No button inside the widget. Primary is the left-bar tile 'Redeem'.
widgets.left_bar_actions: Kicker 'Widget', title 'Credits & tier'. 'Redeem' (gift, primary) — 'Open the catalog with your balance.'; 'Rules' (book) — 'What earns credits, and how many.'; 'Log' (clock) — 'Every credit you earned or spent.'; then Pin, Resize, Hide, Esc.
widgets.opens: Redeem → rewards catalog with balance; Rules → earning rules; Log → credit ledger. No link in the prototype. Suggested repo target: /app/rewards (src/app/app/rewards/page.tsx has 'Credits & rewards', 'How to earn', 'Recent activity', 'Tier progress').
widgets.sizes: S · 3×2 (sizes board): title shortened to 'Credits', body '180' + '160 to Proficient' and the progress bar only. M · 5×3: as desktop; the sizes-board M version additionally shows a stats row '+40 this week', '3 reflections', '1 insight read' that the desktop board does not show.
widgets.states: Normal; selected outline; guide target (step 5). Not drawn: tier reached / max tier, streak broken, zero balance.

widgets.title: Recent routines

interactions: SELECT: clicking a widget's title bar (the full-width header button, aria-label 'Select widget: …') sets state.selected to that widget id (start, tier, recent, insight, partners, report, rewards). Effects: 2px #0E153E inner outline on that card; left bar kicker becomes 'Widget', title becomes the widget name, tiles become that widget's actions (first one red primary) followed by a divider and Pin / Resize / Hide / Esc. Clicking a routine chip also selects 'Start a routine'. Main bar buttons select widgets too: 'Start routine' → start, 'History' → recent, 'Sharing' → partners, 'Report' → report, 'Rewards' → rewards. Re-clicking a selected header keeps it selected (no toggle). Only one widget can be selected.

DESELECT: the 'Esc' tile (aria-label 'Deselect') sets selected = 'none' → outline removed, left bar returns to 'Dashboard' / 'Nothing selected' with Add, Arrange, Reset, Lock. There is NO keyboard Escape handler and no click-outside deselect in the prototype (the label 'Esc' implies the key should work). Guide 'Skip' and 'Finish' also reset selection to none.

ROUTINE PICK: clicking a chip sets state.routine (flight | simulator | training | debrief | coaching), restyles the chips (selected = SOFT bg + navy border) and rewrites 'Partner for {Routine}: …'. Partner name/validity do not change.

DRAG (spec only, not implemented): 'Drag a widget by its title bar to move it.' The six-dot grip in each title bar is the drag affordance; widgets snap to the 12-column grid with 20px gaps; empty space shows as the dashed free cell.

RESIZE (spec only): 'Use Resize in the left bar to pick S, M, L or XL — small widgets show less, large ones show more, text never shrinks.' Changes the span on the grid; content density adapts per size (see widget sizes).
HIDE (spec only): 'Remove it from the canvas (not from the app).' 'Hide what you do not need; Add brings it back.'
PIN (spec only): 'Keep it in place when you auto-arrange.'
ADD FROM LIBRARY (spec only): left-bar 'Add' — 'Choose a widget from the library.'; main bar 'Add' (aria-label 'Add widget') — 'Put a widget on the canvas…'.

ARRANGE (spec only): left-bar 'Arrange' — 'Pack widgets onto the grid without gaps.'; main bar 'Layout' (aria-label 'Arrange layout') — '…or auto-arrange and reset the grid.' Pinned widgets keep their place.
RESET (spec only): left-bar 'Reset' — 'Back to the default layout.'
LOCK (spec only): left-bar 'Lock' — 'Freeze the layout so nothing moves by accident.'
SEARCH: main bar 'Search' button, no behaviour defined.
THEME: main bar 'Theme' (aria-label 'Appearance'), no behaviour and no dark tokens defined.
ACCOUNT: avatar button 'Dana' / 'Captain', no menu defined. 'Org admin' link navigates to Admin.dc.html (org admin console). Logo navigates to Main.dc.html (home).

NAVIGATION LINKS: 'Continue to briefing' → Main.dc.html; every Recent routines row → Main.dc.html; logo → Main.dc.html; 'Org admin' → Admin.dc.html. Every other control is a no-op in the prototype (all generated left-bar tiles have run: () => {}; 'Confirm read · +10' and 'Redeem' have no handler; 'Not enough credits' is disabled).

GUIDE START: main bar 'Guide' (aria-label 'Open the guide') → state.tour = true, guideLeft reset to −9999 to force placement, go(0). Initial page state: tour false, step 0, selected 'none', routine 'flight', guideLeft −9999, guideTop 20.

GUIDE STEP CHANGE go(i): sets step i and, if the step's target is a widget (not 'mainbar'/'ctxbar'/null), selects that widget so the left bar shows its actions; otherwise selected = 'none'. Next (or Finish on step 12 → tour off, deselect), Back (steps 2–12 only), Skip (tour off, deselect). 12 progress dots.

GUIDE SPOTLIGHT: scrim rgba(14,21,62,0.5) over everything at z-index 2 with pointer-events none (app usable underneath). Current target element gets z-index 3 + RING. Left bar is lifted with RING on the ctxbar step AND on every widget step (because it shows that widget's actions); main bar lifted with RING only on its own step.

GUIDE ACTION-ROW HOVER: mouseenter on an action row sets state.hover = row label and state.hoverKeys = row keys; mouseleave clears them. Effects: (1) any left-bar tile whose label equals the row label turns SOFT bg + navy + RING (e.g. hovering 'Redeem' lights the 'Redeem' tile; primary tiles keep red bg but get the RING); (2) keys light main-bar/left-bar controls with RING: StartRoutine → 'Start routine', History, Sharing, Report, Rewards, Add, Layout, Guide → main bar buttons; Pin, Resize, Hide, Esc → the fixed left-bar tiles. Row hover bg oklch(0.93 0.03 275).

GUIDE CARD PLACEMENT (place()): runs when the tour starts, when step changes (next animation frame), on window resize and on any scroll (capture). Constants GAP = 20. Bounds: minLeft = left bar's right edge + 20 (or 20 on ≤720px), maxTop = max(20, min(main bar top, viewport height) − 20 − card height); card never covers the left bar and never sits lower than 20px above the main bar. If the card is already in view and does not overlap the target (with a 20px margin) it stays put. Otherwise candidates in order: right of target (top aligned, clamped), left of target, below (left clamped), above, above right-aligned, then default top-right (W − 20 − cardWidth, 20), then top-left (minLeft, 20). First candidate that is in view and non-overlapping wins; if none fits, choose the corner farthest from the target's centre. Result rounded and clamped; position animates (left/top .35s ease). Steps with no target (1 and 12) land top-right (as in page3.png).
RESPONSIVE: see layout_system — 12→6→1 columns at 1180px / 720px; toolbars scale with clamp(10px, 0.9vw, 13px); main bar wraps; guide card full-width and max 45vh on phone.

HOVER STYLES: .tool:hover and .main:hover declare bg oklch(0.975 0.006 275) and .guide .act:hover bg oklch(0.93 0.03 275); in the prototype the first two are overridden by inline backgrounds, so only the guide row hover is visible.
ANIMATIONS: only the guide card's left/top transition (.35s ease). No widget move/resize animation, no selection transition.

KEYBOARD/A11Y: all controls are native buttons/links (tab-focusable). aria-labels: 'Select widget: Start a routine' | 'Credits and tier' | 'Recent routines' | 'Weekly insight' | 'Consented partners' | 'My report' | 'Rewards catalog'; 'Selected widget tools'; 'Pin widget', 'Resize widget', 'Hide widget', 'Deselect'; nav 'Dashboard'; 'S3 home'; 'Add widget', 'Arrange layout', 'Search', 'Appearance', 'Open the guide'; 'Account: Dana Cohen, Captain'; 'Live guide'; progressbar 'Tier progress'. Decorative icons aria-hidden; scrim and dots aria-hidden. Missing: Escape key, focus ring styling, aria-pressed on chips, selected state announced, focus moved into the guide.
guide_steps: STEP 1 of 12 — target: none (card placed top-right; no ring, no selection). Title: 'Welcome to your canvas'. Body: 'Everything you use sits on one dashboard. Widgets snap to a grid, so you can move them, resize them and hide the ones you never use. This guide walks you through each one — take your time, nothing here is timed.' Actions: none. Try it: 'Move your mouse over the dashboard. The dimmed area is just the guide; the app is fully usable underneath.' Buttons: 'Skip', 'Next' (no Back).

STEP 2 of 12 — target: main bar (z 3 + RING; selection none). Title: 'The main bar is always with you'. Body: 'The bar at the bottom holds the functions of the whole dashboard: start a routine, open your history, sharing, your report and rewards, plus adding widgets, arranging the layout, search, theme and your account. It never changes, whatever you are looking at.' Actions label: 'Main bar'. Actions: 'Start routine' (keys StartRoutine) — 'Begin a flight, simulator, training, debrief or coaching routine.'; 'History' (keys History) — 'Every routine you generated, with its action cards.'; 'Sharing' (keys Sharing) — 'Partners who consented to blind synergy; a dot means a pending request.'; 'Add · Layout' (keys Add, Layout) — 'Put a widget on the canvas, or auto-arrange and reset the grid.' Try it: 'Hover the main bar — each button has a label underneath.' Buttons: Skip, Back, Next.

STEP 3 of 12 — target: left context bar (RING; selection none so it shows the dashboard tools). Title: 'The left bar changes with what you select'. Body: 'Click the title bar of any widget and the left bar shows only the actions for that widget — its primary action on top, then pin, resize, hide and Esc to deselect. With nothing selected it offers the dashboard tools.' Actions label: 'With nothing selected'. Actions: 'Add' — 'Choose a widget from the library.'; 'Arrange' — 'Pack widgets onto the grid without gaps.'; 'Reset' — 'Back to the default layout.'; 'Lock' — 'Freeze the layout so nothing moves by accident.' (hovering lights the same-named left-bar tile). Try it: 'Click any widget title bar and watch the left bar change. Press Esc there to come back.'

STEP 4 of 12 — target: 'Start a routine' widget (selected + ring; left bar shows its tools, ringed). Title: 'Start a routine'. Body: 'The heart of the app. Pick the routine for your next session, see whether a consenting partner is available for it, then continue to the briefing form to get your action cards.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Actions: 'Continue' — 'Go to the briefing form for the chosen routine.'; 'Partner' — 'Switch between solo and a consented partner.'; 'Context' — 'Add aircraft, phase and scenario before generating.'; 'Last used' — 'Repeat your previous routine setup.' Try it: 'Click a different routine chip — the partner line underneath updates for that routine.'

STEP 5 of 12 — target: 'Credits & tier'. Title: 'Credits & tier'. Body: 'CRM Credits reward consistent use: generating routines, reading the weekly insight, reflecting after a session. Credits move you through readiness tiers and can be redeemed in your organization’s catalog.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Actions: 'Redeem' — 'Open the catalog with your balance.'; 'Rules' — 'What earns credits, and how many.'; 'Log' — 'Every credit you earned or spent.' Try it: 'Select the widget and press Rules in the left bar.'

STEP 6 of 12 — target: 'Recent routines'. Title: 'Recent routines'. Body: 'Your last sessions, newest first. Solo means a self-briefing; Blind synergy means a partner’s profile was used — without ever revealing their type to you, or yours to them.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Actions: 'Open last' — 'Jump to the newest session and its cards.'; 'Copy cards' — 'Copy all action cards as text for your briefing notes.'; 'Reflect' — 'Close the loop: what worked, what to change (+20 credits).'; 'Filter' — 'Only solo, only synergy, or by routine.' Try it: 'Open a session and copy its cards — you can paste them anywhere.'

STEP 7 of 12 — target: 'Insight · Week 41'. Title: 'Insight of the week'. Body: 'One short, practical CRM idea per week, chosen for crews like yours. Confirming you read it earns 10 credits and keeps your weekly streak alive.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Actions: 'Confirm' — 'Mark it read, +10 credits, once per week.'; 'Past' — 'Browse earlier insights.'; 'Snooze' — 'Hide it until next week.' Try it: 'Press Confirm read · +10 on the widget itself; both places do the same thing.'

STEP 8 of 12 — target: 'Consented partners'. Title: 'Consented partners'. Body: 'Blind synergy only works with crew who approved a sharing request, for specific routines and for a limited time. This is the anonymity wall: you see names and validity, never anyone’s psychometric type.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Actions: 'Request' — 'Ask a colleague to share for a routine and a number of days.'; 'Review' — 'Approve or decline requests sent to you.'; 'Revoke' — 'Withdraw a consent you gave.' Try it: 'The orange dot means someone is waiting for your answer.'

STEP 9 of 12 — target: 'My report'. Title: 'My report'. Body: 'Your MBTI Step I/II or Symbiotics ADAPT report is what makes every routine personal. Without a verified report, routine generation is blocked. Your type is used by the system only — never shown to partners.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Actions: 'Upload' — 'Add or replace your report (PDF).'; 'Privacy' — 'What is stored, who can see what.'; 'Preview' — 'Check which report is linked and when.' Try it: 'Select the widget and read Privacy once — it is short.'

STEP 10 of 12 — target: 'Rewards catalog'. Title: 'Rewards catalog'. Body: 'What your organization offers for credits — a sim slot of your choice, a coffee with the chief pilot, whatever they add. Cards tell you the cost and how far you are from affording them.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Actions: 'Catalog' — 'The full list, not just the two shown here.'; 'Redeemed' — 'Your past redemptions and their status.'; 'Rules' — 'How credits are earned.' Try it: 'Make this widget wider and it shows three cards instead of two.'

STEP 11 of 12 — target: 'Insight · Week 41' (used as the example selected widget, so Pin/Resize/Hide/Esc are visible). Title: 'Make the canvas yours'. Body: 'Drag a widget by its title bar to move it. Use Resize in the left bar to pick S, M, L or XL — small widgets show less, large ones show more, text never shrinks. Hide what you do not need; Add brings it back. Everything snaps to the same grid, with the same gaps.' Actions label: 'On every selected widget'. Actions: 'Pin' (keys Pin) — 'Keep it in place when you auto-arrange.'; 'Resize' (keys Resize) — 'Change its span on the grid.'; 'Hide' (keys Hide) — 'Remove it from the canvas (not from the app).'; 'Esc' (keys Esc) — 'Deselect.' Try it: 'Drop a widget into the dashed free slot.'

STEP 12 of 12 — target: none (top-right; selection none). Title: 'That’s the whole system'. Body: 'Start a routine, get action cards, reflect, earn credits, and keep your sharing under your control. You can reopen this guide any time from the main bar.' Actions label: 'Main bar'. Actions: 'Guide' (keys Guide) — 'Reopens this walkthrough.' Try it: 'Press Finish, then start your first routine.' Primary button label becomes 'Finish' (closes the guide and deselects).
pages: This is the crew board, not an admin board: a single page, 'Crew dashboard canvas' (the crew member's home), laid out as the canvas described in layout_system: left context bar + 12-column widget canvas + sticky bottom main bar, with the optional live guide overlay. No internal tabs or sub-pages.

Linked destinations in the prototype: 'Main.dc.html' (home / briefing form / session view — target of the logo, 'Continue to briefing' and every Recent routines row) and 'Admin.dc.html' (org admin console — target of 'Org admin' in the main bar). Everything else stays on the canvas (selection + left-bar actions).

Full-data views implied by the left-bar actions and guide copy (where each widget's complete data lives): Start a routine → briefing form with routine, partner (solo / consented partner), context (aircraft, phase, scenario), last-used setup, then generated action cards. Credits & tier → catalog with balance, earning rules, credit log (every credit earned or spent), tiers. Recent routines → full history list with filter (solo / synergy / by routine), session detail with action cards, copy cards, reflection (+20 credits). Insight → past insights archive, confirm (+10 once per week), snooze to next week. Consented partners → request (colleague, routine, number of days), review incoming requests (approve/decline), revoke given consents. My report → upload/replace PDF, privacy explainer, preview of the linked report and date. Rewards catalog → full catalog, my redemptions with status, rules.

Suggested mapping onto existing repo routes (my mapping, for implementation): canvas → /app (src/app/app/page.tsx); briefing/Start → /app form and /app/routines/[id]; Recent/History → /app/routines ('Routines & synergy') and /app/routines/[id]; Partners/Sharing → /app/consents ('Sharing requests', 'Request sharing') and /app/settings 'Sharing & consent'; Report → /app/report; Credits & Rewards → /app/rewards ('Credits & rewards', 'How to earn', 'Recent activity'); Account → /app/settings ('Notifications & privacy', 'Profile'); Org admin → /admin (only for org-admin role).

open_questions: Almost every control is inert in the prototype (all left-bar tiles, Pin, Resize, Hide, Add, Layout, Search, Theme, Account, 'Confirm read · +10', 'Redeem'). Each needs a defined behaviour: inline action, modal/drawer, or navigation to a full page (which route?).

Drag, snap, resize, hide, pin, arrange, reset and lock are specified only in copy. Need rules for collision/reflow, what 'Arrange' packs, how pinned widgets interact, where the per-user layout is persisted (DB table with RLS vs local storage), and whether the org can set a default layout.
Which widgets exist in the 'Add' library beyond the seven shown? What is shown when the library is empty or a widget is already on the canvas?

Size support per widget: S/M/L/XL are defined only for Recent routines (S 3×2, M 4×3, L 5×3, XL 8×4); Start (S 4×2, M 7×3) and Credits (S 3×2, M 5×3) have S/M only; Insight, Partners, Report and Rewards have no size variants (Rewards: 'wider shows three cards').
